tasks.title: Strategic Alignment & Execution Kickoff
tasks.description: Define strategic roadmap milestones based on vision: NPWR helps skincare enthusiasts aged 18-35 who are tech-savvy and seek personalized skincare solutions. get personalized skincare recommendations instantly by simply scanning your products with our app. We ship a focused MVP and grow through a freemium, word-of-mouth motion.

tasks.title: Repo & Environment Architecture Setup
tasks.description: Initialize version control, CI/CD pipeline, and core tech stack: React Native, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, TensorFlow

tasks.title: Core Database & API Infrastructure
tasks.description: Implement foundational backend models, API routes, and integration layer: The MVP will utilize a client-server architecture where the mobile app communicates with a backend server for product database access and AI processing. The backend will handle image recognition and recommendation algorithms.

tasks.title: Build MVP: Basic Routine Recommendations
tasks.description: Provides users with basic skincare routine suggestions based on scanned product data and limited user inputs.

tasks.title: Build MVP: User Profile Setup
tasks.description: Enables users to input basic skin type and concerns to tailor recommendations.

tasks.title: Build MVP: Product Database
tasks.description: A foundational database of skincare products and ingredients to support scanning and recommendations.

tasks.title: QA, Performance & Security Audit
tasks.description: Execute integration testing, security hardening, and load testing prior to launch.

tasks.title: Brand Identity & Messaging Framework
tasks.description: Establish core brand guidelines, value proposition messaging, and persona positioning: NPWR empowers skincare enthusiasts to effortlessly navigate their skincare journey by providing instant, personalized recommendations through AI technology.

tasks.title: Landing Page & Conversion Funnel
tasks.description: Design and deploy responsive product landing page with email capture and CTA analytics.

tasks.title: Growth Channels & Launch Campaign
tasks.description: Set up customer acquisition channels, social proof, and launch strategy: social media marketing, influencer partnerships, skincare community forums

tasks.title: Capital Allocation & Banking Setup
tasks.description: Set up financial accounts, budget allocation controls, and initial treasury management.

tasks.title: Pricing Model & Unit Economics Audit
tasks.description: Finalize pricing tiers, calculate customer acquisition cost (CAC) & lifetime value (LTV) assumptions: Adopt a freemium model, offering basic scanning and routine suggestions for free, while charging for premium features such as advanced AI analysis and personalized consultations.

tasks.title: Burn Rate & Cashflow Financial Controls
tasks.description: Establish monthly operating burn monitoring, runway alerts, and financial report dashboard.

tasks.title: Product-Market Fit & Milestone Review
tasks.description: Review MVP launch results, unit economics, and approve next stage growth expansion.
